question: For the examinations done after 1997/1/1, how many of them have the result of an inactivated partial prothrom bin time?
evidence: examinations done after 1997/1/1 refers to `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'; normal activated partial prothrom bin time refesr to APTT < 45;
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT >= 45
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT >= 45

d.request: For the examinations done after 1997/1/1 (`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'), how many have an inactivated (abnormal) partial prothrombin time result, defined as APTT >= 45? Count each distinct ID only once.
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) FROM Examination AS E INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND L.APTT >= 45

b.request: Among examinations with `Examination Date` after 1997-01-01 whose patient has a laboratory result with an inactivated (abnormal) APTT, meaning APTT >= 45, how many distinct patient IDs are there?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) FROM Examination E WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.ID = E.ID AND L.APTT >= 45)
b.raw: Among examinations with `Examination Date` after 1997-01-01 whose patient has a laboratory result with an inactivated (abnormal) APTT, meaning APTT >= 45, how many distinct patient IDs are there?
